newsitem.title: USA: Blount International stake raised by group.
newsitem.headline: Blount International stake raised by group.

text.p: A group led by Trinity I Fund L.P. and Texas investor Thomas Taylor said Monday it raised its stake in Blount International Inc to 1,092,300 Class A common shares or 8.2 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 127,500 additional Class A common between October 22 and December 20 at prices ranging from $33.28 to $37.84 per share.
Previously, the group had a 7.2 percent stake or 954,800 common shares and held it for investment purposes.
Blount, of Montgomery, Ala., is an international manufacturing company with operations in three business segments: outdoor products, industrial and power equipment and sporting equipment.
Trinity I Fund is a Texas-based limited partnership in the business of purchase, sale, exchange, acquisition and holding of investment securities.
